mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as capital flows into equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% triggers risk-off sentiment as labor market deterioration signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deepening demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >2% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 97.0 indicates manufacturing supply shock, triggering recession fears that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 97.0.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate decline below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary policy easing, immediately boosting equity markets and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 580 thousand units signal consumer confidence recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as housing leads economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 580.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.
